description: The graph illustrates the loss values over iterations for three different configurations of the SepLLM model, with the y-axis representing "Loss" on a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 3.0 and the x-axis representing "#Iteration" on a linear scale from 95,000 to 125,000. The plot includes three distinct lines: a magenta line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", a blue line labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", and an orange line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)". All three lines start at a loss value of approximately 3.0 at the beginning of the iteration range and exhibit a general downward trend. The magenta line shows a steeper initial decline compared to the other two, reaching a loss value of around 2.25 by iteration 100,000 and then gradually leveling off. The blue and orange lines follow a similar trajectory, both decreasing from approximately 3.0 to around 2.25 by iteration 100,000, after which they continue to decrease more slowly, converging towards a loss value of approximately 2.25 by iteration 125,000. A dashed red horizontal line is drawn at a loss value of 2.35, which appears to represent a target or baseline value. The legend indicates that the magenta line corresponds to a configuration with a larger learning rate (lr) for n=64, while the blue and orange lines correspond to configurations with n=128 and n=64, respectively.
